themes.blurb: The chips, and the machines that print them.

themes.name: Cybersecurity
themes.blurb: Who gets paid to keep networks and logins closed.

themes.name: Space
themes.blurb: Rockets, landers, and phones that talk to satellites.

themes.name: Quantum computing
themes.blurb: Machines that are still more lab than product.

themes.name: AI infrastructure
themes.blurb: The buildings and boxes rented out to train models.

ADBE.name: Adobe
ADBE.does: Sells subscription software like Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and Acrobat that people use to edit photos, video, and PDFs; also sells marketing software to companies.

ANET.name: Arista Networks
ANET.does: Sells high-speed switches and software that connect servers inside large data centers and AI clusters.

ASML.name: ASML
ASML.does: Builds the giant machines chipmakers use to print circuit patterns onto silicon wafers.

ASTS.name: AST SpaceMobile
ASTS.does: Builds satellites that beam cell service to regular phones and charges phone companies for that coverage.

AVGO.name: Broadcom
AVGO.does: Sells chips that move data in phones, networks, and AI servers, plus software that companies use to run their computer systems.

CRM.name: Salesforce
CRM.does: Sells cloud software that companies use to track customers, sales, and support tickets.

CRWD.name: CrowdStrike
CRWD.does: Sells subscription software that watches company computers, cloud systems, and logins to detect and stop cyber attacks.

CRWV.name: CoreWeave
CRWV.does: Rents out powerful NVIDIA computers in its data centers so companies can train and run AI models.

IONQ.name: IonQ
IONQ.does: Builds quantum computers and rents access to them through the cloud.

LUNR.name: Intuitive Machines
LUNR.does: Builds spacecraft and lunar landers and flies cargo to the Moon and Earth orbit for NASA and other customers.

NBIS.name: Nebius
NBIS.does: Rents GPU computers and cloud space so companies can train and run AI models.

NET.name: Cloudflare
NET.does: Sits between websites and visitors to speed up pages and block attacks.

NOW.name: ServiceNow
NOW.does: Sells cloud software that automates office work like IT tickets, HR requests, and customer service.

NVDA.name: NVIDIA
NVDA.does: Designs the graphics chips that train and run AI models, plus gaming GPUs and chips for cars and data centers.

PANW.name: Palo Alto Networks
PANW.does: Sells firewalls and cybersecurity software that companies use to protect their networks, cloud systems, and employees.

PLTR.name: Palantir
PLTR.does: Sells software that governments and big companies use to combine their data and run AI on it.

QUBT.name: Quantum Computing Inc.
QUBT.does: Makes photonic chips and room-temperature quantum machines that use light to compute, sense, and send data.

RGTI.name: Rigetti
RGTI.does: Builds superconducting quantum computers and rents access to them through the cloud.

RKLB.name: Rocket Lab
RKLB.does: Launches small satellites on its own rockets and also builds satellites and satellite parts for customers.

SMCI.name: Super Micro Computer
SMCI.does: Designs and sells servers and storage racks, especially AI boxes packed with GPUs, to data centers.

SNOW.name: Snowflake
SNOW.does: Runs a cloud database that companies pay to store and analyze their data.

TSM.name: TSMC
TSM.does: Manufactures computer chips for other companies, including the processors in phones and AI servers.

ZS.name: Zscaler
ZS.does: Sells a cloud service that checks company internet and app traffic to block hacks and data leaks.
